purpose: Machine-checked inventory of every non-test outbound Canvas-mutation-shaped call under api/. Keyed by repo-relative path + qualified enclosing symbol + detector + call_index, never by line number. This file is the machine authority for docs/reference/mutation-reconciliation-map.md and for api/tests/test_canvas_mutation_ownership.py.

detector_legend.attr:<name>: an attribute call, e.g. requests.post(...) or canvas_client._canvas_send(...); <name> is the attribute (post/put/patch/delete/request/_canvas_send/canvas_send).
detector_legend.name:<name>: a bare-name call to an injected/imported callable literally named canvas_send or _canvas_send (dependency-injection parameter or direct import), not accessed via attribute.
detector_legend.alias:<verb>: a mutation-verb HTTP function referenced via assignment aliasing (e.g. http_post = requests.post) rather than called directly at that site.

call_index_note: 1-based occurrence index of the same (path, symbol, detector) triple, in source order. Distinguishes multiple calls of the same kind inside one enclosing symbol without using line numbers.

owners.reason: Creates the unpublished, omitted, SIS-disabled bridge after every exact differentiated source is verified. The central operation-ledger post-apply hook invalidates catalog.assignments after the complete content operation succeeds.

Each copied final row is write-ahead checkpointed and exactly verified; after confirmed grade writes the adapter invokes mirror_service.notify_course_changed once for the course, reusing the targeted submissions delta refresh.
The central operation-ledger post-apply hook invalidates applicable catalog scopes after the confirmed operation succeeds.

Per-student override write. The base override facts are not projected into the mirror at all; the only mirror footprint is the effective due date cached on the affected submission rows (private.submissions cached_due_date), read by the Student Report 'Due date extended to' line. Bounded, low-severity staleness (the report falls back to live Canvas outside the freshness window) — deferred for 1.0beta as a documented bounded limitation, not an open gap. See mutation-reconciliation-map.md family 3.

owners.reason: Patches only the caller-supplied published/due_at/unlock_at/lock_at fields of an existing assignment; description, points_possible, and assignment_group_id are never read or resent. The central operation-ledger post-apply hook invalidates catalog.assignments after the confirmed operation succeeds.

File-upload init only. Spine 14.2 says uploads must never trigger a course-wide binary refresh; there is no evidence-record scope tracked for printable attachments, so 'none' here is the expected steady state, not a gap.
Second leg of the Canvas two-step file upload; the target is a Canvas-issued storage URL, not the core REST API. No JSON scope to reconcile.

Direct webui route: on the success branch (any push ok) it calls mirror_service.notify_course_changed(course_id), which runs sync.refresh_submissions_course_delta — the same narrow per-course submissions delta refresh PowerGrader uses, inline rather than via the _notify_write_through helper. The parallel ledger adapter operation_ledger/adapters/curve.py is dead (no producer emits gradebook.curve); the scheduled-routine path routines_builtin.py _curve_apply_core is the only remaining unreconciled curve writer (Batch 7 unit 02).

Reverting a curve writes posted_grade back and is reconciled identically to the apply path above.
mirror_store.invalidate_late_policy(cid) is called immediately after a verified apply. This whole-scope stale-mark (not a precise merge) is why the state is 'invalidate' rather than 'targeted'.

Roster group-set creation uses this create-only transport after review. Its exact-category reconciliation invokes roster.py's _reconcile_group_category, which targeted-merges the private groups mirror and falls back to invalidation without changing the confirmed write result.

Callers (roster.py, roster_groups.py) invoke _reconcile_group_category after a verified write, which live-refetches only the affected category and merges it via mirror_store.merge_group_category, falling back to whole-document invalidate_groups only on failure.

Roster callers use this returned-membership transport. Reconciliation touches only the checkpointed new category through _reconcile_group_category; existing categories and memberships are never changed.
Same _reconcile_group_category convergence path as create_canvas_group.
Route calls the injected invalidate_groups callback (roster.py's _reconcile_group_category) after a verified create, same targeted-merge-with-invalidate-fallback path as roster_canvas.py.

Scheduled-routine curve writer. Its caller _run_routine_curve fires one coalesced mirror_service.notify_course_changed(course_id) after each course's whole curve batch (once per course that curved at least one assignment), which runs sync.refresh_submissions_course_delta — the same narrow per-course submissions delta refresh PowerGrader and the direct curve routes use. Fire-and-forget; the heartbeat repairs any miss.

The unified MCP Scoring Session submit path calls scoring_apply.apply_plan, which reaches this frozen, drift-checked, receipt-backed grade writer and triggers a narrow mirror refresh after a verified push.

Per spine 14.3, the New Quiz Student Analysis report creation is a read acquisition with a Canvas-side generated artifact, not a content mutation. Must remain a specialized focused path and never be scheduled as routine background metadata work.
Auth-token exchange step of the sessionless native file-resolution chain; no content change.
Native-session bootstrap step used only to resolve New Quiz file-upload evidence; deliberately best-effort and never creates a Canvas write path (module docstring).
